messages:
marta_ops: Heads up — vendor just flagged 8x A100s in the EU pool as held for RMA inspection, ETA uncertain. We need to decide: redispatch from EU to US backlog, or attempt a serial-escrow swap so customer-facing capacity isn't impacted. :worried:

sam_procure: Can we get a firm ETA from the vendor on the inspect clearance? If it's >7 days we should reroute. Also what are the cost implications for cross-border air vs local loaners?

jia_logistics: @sam_procure vendor says customs + depot QC could take 3–10 business days depending on inspector backlog. If we request redispatch to US, lead time to ship and clear is ~4 days express + 2 days US depot staging. We lose 2x days for packaging. :truck:

alex_fw: Quick check — any firmware mismatches on those serials? Last time swap we had 2 cards with older microcode that needed flash and a reboot at depot. If they need FW work, add 24–48h.

kyle_vendor: Confirming vendor note — 2 of the 8 units reported prior fw v1.2.3, depot can flash to v1.3.0 but needs signed manifest and OK from Redwood to proceed. We can do direct redispatch without full RMA paper trail if Redwood signs temporary escrow waiver.

marta_ops: What's the risk of doing an "escrow swap" (temporary serial reassignment) to keep capacity in prod? Any audit/compliance flags? @kyle_vendor

kyle_vendor: Escrow swap means vendor marks units as reserved in their system and sends replacement with AWB flagged as "repair in transit". Risk: tracking mismatch if original units fail later and warranty needs routing. Vendor recommends signed SOW addendum.

sam_procure: Cost comparison: local loaner program estimated at $1,200/unit/day for expedited loaners, cross-border redispatch express ~ $4,500 one-time + customs brokerage. If we expect fix <72h, loaners cheaper for short term; otherwise redispatch better for sustained capacity.

jia_logistics: AWBs from vendor:
```
AWB: EK3456789010
AWB: LH9988776655
```
Both currently marked "awaiting depot QC" in vendor portal. I can open a customs expedite request but need billing approval.

alex_fw: If we do escrow swap, I'll prep an automated check to validate firmware on arrival and trigger flashing job. Can we get depot to run checksum before releasing to prod?

marta_ops: Yes please. Also we need to log this in infra tickets and tag impacted clusters (eu-gpu-pool-2, us-gpu-spot-3). I'll open infra ticket now.

rma_bot: New RMA ticket created #RMA-2026-0894 by marta_ops. Vendor workflow options attached: [escrow_swap, full_rma, redispatch].

sam_procure: Proposal: approve temporary escrow swap + depot flash for the 2 fw units, request vendor sign addendum, and provision 4 local loaners to cover immediate spikes for 48h. Jia, can you confirm loaner availability?

jia_logistics: I have 6 local loaners available in AMS. I'll reserve 4 for 48h and start customs expedite for the two AWBs. Initiating billing code charge to project INFR-RED-02.

kyle_vendor: Copy — vendor will prepare signed addendum and mark AWBs as "repair in transit". We'll also set depot to checksum/flash before release per @alex_fw. ETA for signed doc: 2h.

marta_ops: Great — proceed with escrow swap + loaners. Keep this thread updated with AWB status. :thumbsup:
